entity: Austria — Court of Justice (renewal of Andreas Kumin)
notes: Public expression-of-interest search ('öffentliche Interessentensuche im elektronischen Verlautbarungs- und Informationssystem des Bundes') preceded the government proposal of 6 Aug 2024, but the proposal to the Ministerrat names only the nominee: no number of applications, no shortlist, no ranking. Nomination requires the consent of the Nationalrat Main Committee (Art. 23c(2) B-VG). Value = formal nominee only.

entity: Belgium — Court of Justice / General Court (no vacancy in window)
notes: No Belgian nomination appears in the 2023-2025 appointment decisions reviewed (CURIA press releases 174/24 and 121/25; Council of 26 Mar 2025; Decision (EU) 2025/1185). Belgian proposals are announced in Council of Ministers communiqués naming only the proposed person(s) (e.g. 29 Oct 2021, two General Court judges). No public call, applicant list or shortlist located; the news.belgium pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch.

entity: France — General Court (seat vacated by Stéphane Gervasoni)
notes: Public call for the General Court post (term 7 Oct 2024 to 31 Aug 2025), deadline 15 June 2024, advertised by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (diplomatie.gouv.fr title: 'Appel à candidatures pour le poste de juge au Tribunal de l'Union européenne (15.06.24)'). No number of applications, shortlist or ranking published; Hervé Cassagnabère was proposed and appointed by decision of 2 Oct 2024.

Gervasoni moved from the General Court to the Court of Justice (decision of 3 July 2024). No French call for this Court of Justice seat located; the June 2024 call covered the General Court post only. Only the nominee was published.

entity: Germany — Court of Justice (renewal of Thomas von Danwitz)
notes: Nomination by the Bundesregierung with the consent of the Richterwahlausschuss (Richterwahlgesetz §1(3)); the Bundestag research note of 2 Aug 2024 states expressly that, unlike Austria, there is no public advertisement of the post. The committee decides by secret ballot (§§11-12 RiWG); no applicant list, shortlist or ranking is published. Only the nominee becomes public.

entity: Germany — General Court (renewals of Johannes Laitenberger and Gabriele Steinfatt)
notes: Two renewals for 1 Sep 2025 to 31 Aug 2031 (decisions of 26 Mar 2025 and 11 Jun 2025). Same Richterwahlgesetz route; no public call, applicant count or candidate list located.

entity: Italy — Court of Justice (Massimo Condinanzi) and Advocate General (Andrea Biondi)
notes: No public call located. Law 234/2012 art. 17 requires the government, when proposing or designating Italian members of the Court of Justice, to inform the Chambers of the procedure followed, the reasons for the choice and the CVs of the persons proposed; the competent committees may hear them after taking office, including for confirmations. Only the two nominees became public.

entity: Italy — General Court (Francesco Bestagno and Raffaella Pezzuto)
notes: Two first-term appointments (decisions of 26 Mar 2025 and 11 Jun 2025). No public call, applicant count or shortlist located; the law 234/2012 art. 17 informativa applies.

entity: Spain — Court of Justice (no vacancy in window)
notes: No Court of Justice vacancy in 2023-2025: the Spanish judge took office on 7 Oct 2021. Under Real Decreto 972/2020 a competitive procedure is opened by a BOE order (arts. 3-4). The last such call, Orden PCM/121/2021 (BOE 13 Feb 2021), published the criteria, a five-member selection committee and a 20-day deadline, but not a number of applications or a list of candidates.

entity: Spain — General Court (renewals of José Martín y Pérez de Nanclares and Miguel Sampol Pucurull)
notes: Renewals under art. 8 of Real Decreto 972/2020: the outgoing judge asks the Minister of Justice for renewal and the Council of Ministers decides; a public call is required only if renewal is refused. No BOE convocatoria for 2025; only the two nominees and the renewal decision are public.

entity: Portugal — Court of Justice judgeship (2024 selection)
notes: Public call; an evaluation panel shortlisted three candidates (Gonçalo de Almeida Ribeiro, Carla Farinhas, Sofia Oliveira Pais), heard by the Assembleia da República European Affairs Committee on 3 July 2024 (minutes ATA 12/XVI, 1st SL, saved as sources/official/probes/national_cjeu_a/pt-ata-cae-12-2024.pdf). The government formalised Almeida Ribeiro; the Art. 255 panel gave a negative opinion in Sept 2024, objecting that he lacked the 20 years' professional experience the panel requires (Público/Lusa, 30 Oct 2024; AR minutes ATA 26/XVI of 26 Nov 2024 record the resulting request to hear panel president Allan Rosas). A new candidate was announced in Dec 2024 and a fresh call for the same post opened on 25 Aug 2026 (deadline 21 Sep 2026), again with a three-candidate shortlist and parliamentary hearing. The Portuguese records call the post 'juiz do Tribunal de Justiça da União Europeia' but do not state the term of office or the outgoing member. Value = size of the published shortlist, not applications.

Open application procedure: vacancy posted 14 July 2023, deadline 4 Sept 2023, interviews 11-12 Sept 2023; an independent committee (President of the Hoge Raad, Vice-President of the Raad van State, one third member) recommends at least three people, but the procedure agreement of 4 July 2023 states the recommendation 'is niet openbaar' (not public). Herke Kranenborg was first proposed, withdrew, and the Council of Ministers approved Smulders on 12 April 2024. No applicant count published.

Public call launched 28 June 2023; national selection committee created by ministerial decree of 18 Sept 2023; interviews in Oct 2023; the government announced only the selected candidate on 25 Oct 2023. No number of applications or list of candidates published.

Public call published 26-27 April 2024 in six newspapers (Luxemburger Wort, Tageblatt, Quotidien, Lëtzebuerger Land, Zeitung vum Lëtzebuerger Vollek, WOXX), on the Ministry of Justice website and in the Journal officiel; committee created 28 May 2024; interviews 8 July 2024; only the selected candidate announced 17 July 2024. No applicant count or shortlist published.

entity: Ireland — General Court (renewals of Suzanne Kingston and Colm Mac Eochaidh)
notes: Renewals for 1 Sep 2025 to 31 Aug 2031 (decision of 2 Oct 2024). No application process located for the renewals. Ireland's documented procedure for a contested seat is a public call: the June 2021 notice invited applications by 12 July 2021 and set up an expert panel chaired by Nial Fennelly; applicants were not named.
